1d777ky:252: With the release of RAMPART and Clarity, Microsoft extends its AI security testing toolchain to the earliest stages of the development process. This contrasts with the traditional practice of penetration testing after the system is complete, reflecting the "shift left" security philosophy.

q9wvv3:210: RAMPART's core capability is that it only needs an adapter connecting the agent to the test suite to launch attacks or probes against the agent, exploring potential security violations such as cross-prompt injections—that is, indirectly injecting untrusted data into the AI system via data sources the agent processes like emails, files, or web pages. Test results are automatically evaluated and reported by RAMPART, meaning security testing can transform from ad-hoc red teaming activities into part of an automated CI/CD pipeline.
